_doc: Registry of evaluation checkpoints for eval_history.py and the Brief Eval Tracker page. One entry per measured code state: which outputs/e2e/checkpoint_<dir> holds it, which arm, what changed, and whether it is comparable (same briefs, normal login speed). Brief names stay in the git-ignored outputs, never here. `repeat_of` marks a checkpoint whose brief behaviour did not change from the named one (same evidence, same prompts): the pair measures run-to-run noise for checkpoint_run's noise line.

4 SMP drafts instead of 6, one per angle seed (BRIEF_SMP_CANDIDATES=4, CC4 remainder): 247 vs 234 on 6 drafts (noise), 297 s vs 347 s, Claude $1.08 vs $1.13; same-drafts replay: verdicts on drafts 1-4 unchanged (86% = the judge's own noise), a passing draft every time. Adopted as the default
